description: Prioritize testing whether a catalogue buyer can submit a complete inquiry from the live instructions. The completed reply rehearsal gives us a tested delivery baseline. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. A real eligible inquiry can proceed through the authorized incoming workflow independently of the pending outbound decision. Quoting on the provisional CAD 60 terms still requires operator approval, and accepting an order requires a separate administrative action.
